description.value: An open-label feasibility study evaluating accelerated high-frequency repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation effects on relapse-related BOLD activation in recently detoxified alcohol-dependent patients.

spans.text: The major objectives of this open-label feasibility study are to replicate previous findings that baseline brain activation can be a predictor of relapse and also, to evaluate how accelerated right DLPFC HF-rTMS may affect the neurocircuit implicated in relapse.

value: At baseline, we expected to find lower neuronal activation in the relapse circuit, especially in the vmPFC and ACC.
We hypothesized that during the presentation of alcohol-related stimuli accelerated HF-rTMS would increase neuronal activation in the abstainers only, in particular in the vmPFC and ACC.

description.value: Open-label feasibility study with before and after HF-rTMS scans and relapse-status groups.
